Name: Cook with any size milk
Author: Driya
Description:
When I was working on the achievement for cooking everything, I noticed that certain foods like chowder or artichoke dip specifically required the smaller size of milk. It's ridiculous to ignore some of your animals or buy new ones just for a handful of recipes, so I made this.

Where does the extra milk the recipe doesn't call for go? Your farmer drinks it or something, I don't know.

This is just a simple edit to CookingRecipes.xnb, this mod won't be compatible with anything else that edits that file.

UPDATE, version 1.1: Added updated versions of the cookingrecipes file in languages other than English. Thanks to s2sky for pointing out that other languages weren't affected.
